angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 10,355,067 km at 55.76 pc = 2.48 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.9335 +/- 0.1456 mas (same row, RUWE 1.22): 55.76 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 14.884 (14.567 to 15.203) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 10,355,067 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.297 (3.257 to 3.337) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5114 +/- 1.4 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1041808368494264576: teff_gspphot 5114.489 K (16th-84th percentiles 5113.037-5115.935), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1041808368494264576: teff_gspphot 5114.489 K (16th-84th percentiles 5113.037-5115.935), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/muscida.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 2.611, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of omi UMa (pscomppars): spectral type G4 II-III, from Teng et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75.1030T/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * omi UMa: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of omi UMa (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.16 dex, from Teng et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75.1030T/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of omi UMa (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 2.06266, from Teng et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023PASJ...75.1030T/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/A+A/177/131/table2 (CaII and MgII excess flux density in cool stars), column Per: 53 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/A+A/177/131/table2 (CaII and MgII excess flux density in cool stars), column Per: 53 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of omi UMa (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.83 km/s, from Sato et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64..135S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (14.884 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.270. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
